authority: public discovery and demo of youth-development and safeguarding-support concepts; private role-based records remain account-bound
boundaries: not an emergency-response service and does not guarantee immediate counselor, crisis-specialist or authority connection
wellness check-ins are reflection/support signals, not diagnoses, mental-health assessments, safety scores or predictions
does not certify a child, adult or organization as safe or trustworthy
no automated dangerousness or trustworthiness labeling
no public youth leaderboard, cold contact with minors or public spotlight/opportunity handoff without required consent
individual youth profiles, wellness data, messages, parent/guardian connections and school records are private
public demos and sample content are not evidence of real people or live incidents
discovery creates no authority to contact a minor

guardian.name: Guardian Safeguard
guardian.description: Verified outside-support navigation when a concern needs to leave the activity environment.

infinite-classroom.name: Infinite Classroom
infinite-classroom.description: Learning support when the next need is academic or cross-subject education.

talent-atlas.name: Talent Atlas
talent-atlas.description: Only a controlled, consented opportunity handoff when a candidate is genuinely ready.

evernest.name: EverNest
evernest.description: Family support and practical household coordination can continue outside the youth-activity development context.
